title: A Day In The Old West Adventure including Horseback Ride and Cowboy Lunch
blurb:
Go on a horseback riding adventure with some real cowboys!! You'll go back in time to the 1800s on this trail ride that takes you into incredible hills and cactus filled deserts. Then have an amazing time with the western activities....learn how to shoot an arrow.... throw an axe... and try your hand at roping a steel calf. It's all in a day's work on the ranch! The lunch includes a hamburger, hot dog or grilled chicken, beans, corn on the cob, chips, dessert and unlimited soft drinks. 

NOTE: There are two outfitter locations mentioned in the listing. We go to ONE of those, depending on availability and season. 

Please note that during the hot summer months, this tour may be slightly different than described above.
